lesson: Orlando Pirates was covered at 20%, but the forecast overconcentrated at 75% on historically dominant Mamelodi Sundowns without reliable current-table evidence. For domestic league-title questions, current standings and remaining fixtures must dominate long-run club strength; stay broader when those inputs are unavailable.
The direct country-specific reporting correctly supported a near-certain Bangladesh forecast.
The role, form and squad evidence correctly made Bruno Fernandes the dominant outcome and the 84% forecast resolved correctly.
